armor_scaling: Normal50; original JE_makeEnemy difficulty scaling preserved, max254 for finite source armor.

animation.frames: Exactly one base per record. No separate animation, firing animation, damage image or wreck image.

nonfatal_damage: Armor changes; all source imagery remains the same. No threshold form: dlevel0 is unreachable in nonlethal armorleft>damage branch.

filter.hit_link_propagation: Same nonzero link shares ground palette filter; linked finite armor actors are eligible.
filter.ice_state: damage99 sets iced40 for struck/linked ground actors; ice countdown and filter0x09 occur after movement. Ice does not stop horizontal acceleration, scrolling or bounds checks.
filter.engine_semantics: Original per-draw filter clears after draw; preserve indexed/filter handling, do not author separate tinted assets.

death.linked_scope: Lethal damage to a member removes live actors matching its link. Each of links7/8/9/10 is separate; not a single33-piece health group. Generic broader link rules remain unchanged.
death.conditions: Large explosion setup requires y>=0 and free original pools; individual setup y bounds and random repeated positions apply. Shared existing effect assets, no new family-specific explosion.

offscreen_removal.y: after movement ey<-112 or ey>190 before tempBackMove is added
offscreen_removal.sentinel999: Generic removal path exists, but family has no selected999 frame.

body_collision.conditions: Original coordinate collision and noninvulnerable player; enemyAvail0 and even explosiontype8.
body_collision.nonfatal: Damages actor and player; may impart pushback based on original velocity and armor.
body_collision.lethal: Removes linked live actors and emits same shared large explosions; no alternate wreck.

shadow: No separate shadow draw; original black/dark pixels are part of opaque sprite mask.

drops.meaning: Types20/23 have source cash value500 on lethal shot destruction, not a pickup sprite. No family-specific dropped item or weapon dependency. Earlier link assignments do not persist through JE_makeEnemy resetting enemydie0.
